lookup_op_code: lookup the SPIR-V opcode integer value for a given operation name from spv['Op']
lookup_source_language: lookup the SPIR-V source language integer value from spv['SourceLanguage']
lookup_execution_model: lookup the SPIR-V execution model integer value from spv['ExecutionModel']

lookup_decoration: lookup the SPIR-V decoration integer value from spv['Decoration']
